plates.purpose: Diagnostic plate: used only to differentiate a protan-type from a deutan-type red-green deficiency, not for the primary normal/deficient screening decision.
plates.notes: Shinobu Ishihara, 'The Series of Plates Designed as a Test for Colour Deficiency' (38 Plates Edition), Kanehara Trading Inc., Tokyo -- official instruction manual (numerals/scoring rule cross-checked against multiple independently published copies of the manual). Per-plate protan/deutan numeral breakdown (e.g. which half of the two-digit number a protan vs. a deutan reads) was only partially/ambiguously recoverable from the sources reviewed for this pass, so protanResponse/deutanResponse are intentionally left null rather than guessed. Populate these from a verified copy of the official manual before enabling subtype estimation for this plate; until then the app will report "Subtype could not be reliably estimated."

This application's current answer UI only supports numeral text answers, not line-tracing input, so plates of this type are excluded from automatic selection until a tracing-response UI is built (see testSessionService.js).
